dependencies.$comment: libcrypto for the update verifier (Ed25519, BLAKE2b-512, SHA-256). Already in the graph on Linux through curl's ssl feature; on Windows curl uses Schannel and this is the only thing that builds it. See CMakeLists.txt.
dependencies.name: openssl

bundled-allocator.description: Carry an allocator in the binary instead of using the C library's. A feature rather than a dependency because only the static musl build asks for it: musl's allocator is deliberately small and simple, and the scan is malloc-heavy enough for that to cost real throughput. CMakeLists.txt decides what to do with it and docker/build/Linux-musl/build-inside.sh is what selects it.
